limitation: Conservative analytic lower bound using a finite entropy certificate, not an exact optimum or LLM effect. External review and novelty comparison outstanding.

limitation: A separate family from C11-C12; growing exact memory does not imply a nonvanishing excess-error gap. Novelty unresolved.
